slides.title: THE ORDER
slides.note: Multiplication and division share a level, and so do addition and subtraction.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
steps: Multiply and divide left to right: 2 × 9 = 18, then 18 ÷ 3 = 6

slides.title: WATCH OUT
points: Multiplication and division go left to right, as they appear.
The same is true for addition and subtraction.
Fraction bars act like parentheses around the top and bottom.
